premise: Tum {{playerName}} ho — raat-shift delivery rider, 'Tokro' app ka top partner (98% on-time, 4.9 rating). Aaj 2:11 AM, barish, aur tumhare paas ek 'Night Priority' order hai: 'Black Lifafa — no photo, no signature, hand over verbally', 18,000 rupaye tip, hotel Green Fortune ka room 304. Tumhe pehli baar pata chala jab hub ne order 'priority' mein daala tha: is tier par tum 3 baar kaam kar chuke ho, aur teeno baar tumne poocha nahi. Aaj lifafa halka hai, corridor khaali hai, aur darwaaze par koi 'guest' 3 ghante se intezaar nahi kar raha — andar se koi awaaz aati hai. Ek taraf app ka 'mark as delivered' button hai, doosri taraf 100 ka number, teesri taraf lifafa. Inspector Ishaan Kulkarni 3 mahine se isi network ka peechha kar raha hai, aur local station mein Zambetari 'civil matter' bolkar file dabaa deta hai.

locations.name: Hotel Green Fortune, ground + 2nd floor
locations.description: 1962 ka art-deco building, 2019 mein 'renovated'. 2 band cameras, 1 chalu camera (1st floor), aur ek emergency exit jo store ke peeche se khulta hai.

locations.name: 2nd floor ka corridor
locations.description: 14 meter, green carpet, room 304 kone mein. Light 4 baar flicker karti hai — har baar koi nahi aata.

locations.name: Tokro hub, Kothrud
locations.description: 24x7 counter, 6 chairs, 1 printer jo hamesha 'out of paper' hai. Guddu Bhai ki chair sabse garam.

locations.name: Junction ki tapri
locations.description: 4 stool, cutting chai, aur ek CCTV camera jo police station ke saamne se dikhta hai. Ishaan yahin milta hai kyunki 'yahan recording nahi hoti'.

locations.name: Deccan police station
locations.description: Complaint register, 1 bench, 4 baje ki chai. Yahan 'likhwa diya' ka matlab hai 'ab intezaar karo'.

factions.name: 'Black Lifafa' ka tier
factions.description: Hotel, 2 'agents', 1 app manager, aur 4 riders jinke paas 'priority' aati hai. Koi document nahi — sirf 'verbal handover'.

factions.name: PI Ishaan + 1 constable
factions.description: 3 mahine ka kaagaz, bina permission. Saboot ka intezaar: ek lifafa, ek GPS log, ek screenshot.

factions.name: Zambetari ka register
factions.description: Procedure, 25 minute, aur 'civil matter'. Koi bura insaan nahi — bas ek system jo chalta rehta hai.

lore: 'Black Lifafa' app ka official naam nahi — riders ka slang hai. Order type 'NPL-4' hota hai: No Photo, No Signature, No PIN, No Ledger.
Tokro ke terms mein 'handover failed' ka matlab: rider ke wallet se 2,000 cut, aur 90 din ka 'review'. Tumhara contract 11 page ka hai; page 6 mein yahi hai.
Green Fortune ke 304 room ke 4 doors hain: main, balcony, store-attached, aur 'service' — aur service waala camera 2 hafte se 'under maintenance' hai.

2019 se is shehar mein 4 'night courier' networks pakde gaye; teeno baar file 'missing witness' ki wajah se band hui. Chauthi baar ek rider ke phone ka GPS log bacha hua tha — 5:40 AM tak server par rehta hai.
Tara ka 'loan' ek placement agent ke through 2 lakh ka hai, ab 4 lakh. Kaagaz uske naam par hai, aur uske papa ke signature ki photocopy ke saath.
rules: User kabhi physical fight ya weapon use nahi karega; uske paas sirf 3 tools hain: phone, camera, aur uska decision.
Tara ka 'na' final hai — woh user ke plan ki 'reward' nahi hai. Koi bhi choice usse 'convince' nahi karayega.
Koi bhi personal data (ID, photo, address) public/post nahi kiya jaayega — kahani usse nuksan dikhaayegi.
Zambetari cartoon villain nahi hai — woh system ka vyaktikaran hai; uski har line 'polite' rahegi.
App ka algorithm sirf data deta hai; woh insano ko nuksan nahi pahunchata — insaan (hub, sender) pahunchate hain.
Violence sirf implication mein, aur uska asar hamesha dikhega (kaanpna, galat soch, late effect) — glamour kabhi nahi.

importantObjects.name: Black lifafa
importantObjects.description: 40 hazaar cash, Tara ka ID photocopy, aur ek 'asset receipt' — 26 number ke saath.

importantObjects.name: Tumhara phone, 34% battery
importantObjects.description: GPS log, order timer, aur 'Report an issue' ka ek button jo 3 mahine se koi nahi dabata.

importantObjects.name: Helmet ka camera
importantObjects.description: 12 minute ki clip. Card bahar nikalne se pehle usmein sab hai — tumhara 'guilt' ya tumhara 'saboot'.

importantObjects.name: Tara ka bus ticket
importantObjects.description: Nashik 6:15 AM. 3 din se 'not cancelled', kyunki cancel karne ke liye 'sender' ka OTP chahiye.

timeline: 2:26 AM — hotel ke bahar; lobby khaali, night manager soya hua.
2:47 AM — corridor, room 304, andar se awaaz.
3:00 AM — 'guest' ka ETA (function hall, private party).
5:40 AM — app ka GPS log overwrite hota hai. Usse pehle faisla.
